{{Quote|We not bloodthirsty people!|[[G'hinji Dros]]|<ref name="Marvel Star Wars 62">[[Star Wars (1977) 62|''Star Wars'' (1977) 62]]</ref>}}
The '''Em'liy''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shalyvane]]. Originally a proud society of warriors, their civilization was devastated by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] forces. This forced them to become a nomadic society, both on their homeworld and in other [[Star system/Legends|star systems]].

==Biology and appearance==
Em'liy were fairly tall and robust by [[Human/Legends|Human]] standards. Their faces had no visible noses and small, dark eyes. Their skin color varied from bright orange or tan to dark green or blue. They had no body hair, though they did grow dark hair on their heads. This hair was styled in one to three topknots, depending on caste.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />

==History==
{{Quote|City was being lived in by my own people! Yes! Was great majesty, and wonderful comfort. But then, one day city die! Bombs fall from ships flown by people called 'Empire', yes? No reason then – no reason now. But bombs turn city to ruins, and turn my people to homeless nomads.|G'hinji Dros|<ref name="Marvel Star Wars 62" />}}
[[File:GhinjiDros-SW1977-62.jpg|thumb|left|150px|[[G'hinji Dros]], an elderly Em'liy]]
The Em'liy once had a relatively sophisticated society, though they were apparently not starfarers. This changed after the Galactic Empire's forces, under the direction of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], [[Cleansing of Shalyvane|attacked]] Shalyvane. The attack left their capital city, [[Chinshassa]], in ruins.<ref name="Marvel Star Wars 62" /> After this attack, the region around the capital was ruled by nomadic tribes, armed with a mixture of primitive weapons and [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. It is unclear if the blasters were of local manufacture or scavenged from offworlders.<ref name="Marvel Star Wars 60">[[Star Wars (1977) 60|''Star Wars'' (1977) 60]]</ref>

As part of her cover story, Imperial operative [[Lumiya|Shira Brie]] told [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and other members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] that Shalyvane had once been host to a [[Human/Legends|Human]] society, which was destroyed in a war with the Em'liy.<ref name="Marvel Star Wars 60" /> After the Rebel forces learned the truth of the matter,<ref name="Marvel Star Wars 62" /> the Em'liy came into contact with the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Some Em'liy began to rebuild their capital city, while others continued their nomadic lifestyle by traveling from system to system.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />

==Culture==
Em'liy were quite religious, with the [[Circle of Kavaan/Legends|Circle of Kavaan]] in Chinshassa a particularly holy place for them. After the Empire's desecration of the Circle, the Em'liy tribes were quite hostile to offworlders, though Luke Skywalker was able to get access to the Circle by proving his "gods" (i.e. [[The Force/Legends|The Force]]) were strong with him.<ref name="Marvel Star Wars 62" />

The Em'liy divided themselves into four castes: the [[Argwin]], [[Damilini]], [[Criclamon]], and [[Dojufi]] (named for four of their gods). The large Em'liy pantheon of gods and goddesses also included [[Dra'jhok]], [[Dra'vil]], [[Felid Slin]], [[Courtra'paeas]], [[Eeh'cra Niw'dug]], and [[Kavaan]].
